tools.name: Qnami ProteusQ Scanning NV Microscope
researchArea: Magnetic materials at the atomic scale
tools.shortDescription: Complete scanning NV (nitrogen-vacancy) quantum microscope for imaging surface magnetic fields of advanced materials at the nanoscale.
tools.detailedDescription: The Qnami ProteusQ is a turnkey quantum microscope based on scanning NV magnetometry (SNVM). It combines NV center magnetic field sensing with scanning probe microscopy to capture sample topography and local magnetic fields with nanoscale resolution. Designed for room-temperature operation with dedicated control and analysis software.
specs: Measurement technique: Scanning NV magnetometry (SNVM) using NV centers in diamond
Operation mode: Room-temperature, low-drift scanning NV magnetometer
Magnetic sensitivity: Better than ~2 µT/√Hz in continuous-wave ODMR mode (typical)

Key features: Single NV center sensitivity for atomic-layer magnetic signals; qualitative and quantitative magnetic imaging modes; quantilever probes optimized for high optical throughput; turnkey alignment-free confocal optics and integrated electronics
Applications: Magnetic textures in thin films and multilayers, skyrmions and domain walls, superconductors and vortex imaging, 2D magnetic materials and heterostructures
Software: SmartScan SPM control; LabQ software for SNVM and ODMR; scripting support via Jupyter/Python
safetyNotes: Follow standard laser safety practices when working near the optical beam path.
Observe ESD precautions when loading sensitive nanoelectronic/spintronic samples.
Avoid mechanical shocks to the Quantilever probes.
Maintain a clean, dust-free environment around optics and scanner.

content.info:
Qnami ProteusQ Scanning NV Microscope
Vendor: Qnami | Model: ProteusQ | Location: MTW – Nanoelectronics Metrology Suite

Complete scanning NV (nitrogen-vacancy) quantum microscope for imaging surface magnetic fields of advanced materials at the nanoscale.

The Qnami ProteusQ is a turnkey quantum microscope based on scanning NV magnetometry (SNVM). It combines NV center magnetic field sensing with scanning probe microscopy to capture sample topography and local magnetic fields with nanoscale resolution. Designed for room-temperature operation with dedicated control and analysis software.

Measurement technique: Scanning NV magnetometry (SNVM) using NV centers in diamond
Operation mode: Room-temperature, low-drift scanning NV magnetometer
Magnetic sensitivity: Better than ~2 µT/√Hz in continuous-wave ODMR mode (typical)
Key features: Single NV center sensitivity for atomic-layer magnetic signals; qualitative and quantitative magnetic imaging modes; quantilever probes optimized for high optical throughput; turnkey alignment-free confocal optics and integrated electronics
Applications: Magnetic textures in thin films and multilayers, skyrmions and domain walls, superconductors and vortex imaging, 2D magnetic materials and heterostructures
Software: SmartScan SPM control; LabQ software for SNVM and ODMR; scripting support via Jupyter/Python

Safety / handling:
• Follow standard laser safety practices when working near the optical beam path.
• Observe ESD precautions when loading sensitive nanoelectronic/spintronic samples.
• Avoid mechanical shocks to the Quantilever probes.
• Maintain a clean, dust-free environment around optics and scanner.

tools.name: Park Systems NX-Hivac High Vacuum AFM
tools.shortDescription: High-vacuum atomic force microscope designed for failure analysis and air-sensitive materials, enabling high-accuracy nanoscale measurements with minimal tip and sample damage.
tools.detailedDescription: The Park NX-Hivac is a research-grade AFM engineered for high-vacuum operation. High vacuum improves measurement accuracy and repeatability while reducing probe and sample wear. The platform supports a range of AFM modes and can integrate advanced electrical characterization modules for semiconductor workflows.
specs: Environment: High vacuum chamber optimized for low outgassing
Scan system: Orthogonal XY scan with decoupled Z for low cross-talk
Modes: True Non-Contact™ AFM; Contact/tapping modes (depending on configuration); advanced modes such as SSRM and SCM when integrated with external electronics
Applications: Failure analysis of semiconductor devices; dopant profiling via SSRM; carrier distribution via SCM; morphology of air-sensitive thin films and 2D materials
safetyNotes: Ensure samples/holders are vacuum-compatible and free of volatile contaminants.
Follow vacuum procedures when venting/pumping the chamber.
Use careful approach steps to protect the AFM tip and delicate devices.

content.info:
Park Systems NX-Hivac High Vacuum AFM
Vendor: Park Systems | Model: NX-Hivac | Location: MTW – High Vacuum AFM Bay

High-vacuum atomic force microscope designed for failure analysis and air-sensitive materials, enabling high-accuracy nanoscale measurements with minimal tip and sample damage.

The Park NX-Hivac is a research-grade AFM engineered for high-vacuum operation. High vacuum improves measurement accuracy and repeatability while reducing probe and sample wear. The platform supports a range of AFM modes and can integrate advanced electrical characterization modules for semiconductor workflows.

Environment: High vacuum chamber optimized for low outgassing
Vacuum level: Down to ~10^-5 Torr (typical)
Chamber volume (mm): 325 × 420 × 320
Scan system: Orthogonal XY scan with decoupled Z for low cross-talk
Modes: True Non-Contact™ AFM; Contact/tapping modes (depending on configuration); advanced modes such as SSRM and SCM when integrated with external electronics
Applications: Failure analysis of semiconductor devices; dopant profiling via SSRM; carrier distribution via SCM; morphology of air-sensitive thin films and 2D materials

Safety / handling:
• Ensure samples/holders are vacuum-compatible and free of volatile contaminants.
• Follow vacuum procedures when venting/pumping the chamber.
• Avoid overtightening sample clamps.
• Use careful approach steps to protect the AFM tip and delicate devices.
